notes.title: Update: Undo Button
notes.content: Some Triangulum levels are no joke, and restarting after a small mistake doesn't help, especially if you want to recreate the same string of moves. Those pains are now gone with the new undo feature! Press the undo button to rewind your previous move. Undo as much as you like, all your moves will be remembered! Hopefully this makes some of the harder puzzles more enjoyable to complete!
